source.evaluation: Existing evaluator definitions only, before reports={}; complete located hierarchy, cubic streamed curves and constant channels; unknown path bindings excluded.
limitations: Not a reproduction of the original Animator state machine, blending, ground contacts, or DynamicBone solver.
Run_New2 is a source pose reference; its in-game state selection is not established by its name.
Normalized targets and measured angles are references for retargeting; do not copy source bone lengths or animated local translations.

coordinates.angles: radians in Godot y-down actor space
coordinates.near: source right/youbi, held forward, foreground render layer
coordinates.far: source left/zuobi, swinging arm, rear render layer
coordinates.wrist: wrist minus same-side shoulder, divided by that frame's same-side shoulder-elbow-wrist chain length
coordinates.upper_angle: absolute projected shoulder-to-elbow direction; use to choose IK bend side
coordinates.body_lean: atan2(neck.x-waist.x, neck.y-waist.y) in source y-up; positive is forward lean
coordinates.cloth_root_angle: wrapped Godot root-to-mid direction minus PI/2; positive trails backward
coordinates.phase: source clip time divided by duration, samples [0,1); interpolate cyclically
coordinates.alignment: source phase = current near-leg phase + nearFrontmostPhase; far-leg phase supplied separately includes an additional half-cycle
